# Security Policy

## Supported versions

The latest released major version receives security fixes.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Report privately through
[GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/karakosystems/karako-cdn/security/advisories/new),
or by email to security@karakosystems.com. Please do not open a public
issue.

Include what is affected, how to reproduce it and the impact you see. We
acknowledge reports within five working days and keep you posted until a
fix ships. Please give us reasonable time before any public disclosure.

## Scope

The server, the `oggen` tool and the published image. Assets served by a
downstream project are that project's responsibility.
